solves.reason: 원문: apparently flexible price-setting / more enduring ties / are aware of each other's restrictions. flexible-enduring-aware.

①rigid 자리는 원문 flexible(유연한 가격결정). '경직된'은 apparently flexible과 모순. ①이 부적절.
